control_owner.authorization: capability policy plus human approval only for optional external proposal release
control_owner.success_verdict: deterministic candidate gates plus an evaluator independent of the producer and bound to exact evidence and candidate hashes
control_owner.effects: outbox dispatcher with idempotency and release reconciliation

RetrieveAssociations.risk: read-only retrieval of untrusted adjacent evidence

GenerateCandidates.risk: bounded model call whose output is untrusted and may consume tokens or cost

EvaluateCandidate.risk: bounded independent judgment call that cannot alone authorize success

PublishProposedBundle.risk: optional externally visible publication of an immutable artifact explicitly labeled PROPOSED

transitions.evidence: validated run contract, input evidence hash, and budget snapshot
normalized repeated-pattern snapshot with source provenance
content-addressed association batch and retrieval receipt
recorded producer response, producer identity, and candidate hashes
deterministic evidence coverage, novelty, compression, counterexample, and lexical-echo checks
content-addressed correctable-failure receipt bound to candidate, evidence, evaluator, and contract hashes
all deterministic gates plus distinct-evaluator pass receipt and calibrated threshold version
typed terminal falsifier or exhausted candidate set
new content hash, changed semantic fingerprint, correction delta, and remaining budget
calibrated low-gain window over evidence-and-candidate fingerprints
bounded attempt ledger and last classified transient failure
immutable PROPOSED bundle returned to the caller without KG, canon, or source mutation
exact proposal artifact, destination, visibility, and workflow hashes
one-time approval binding exact immutable content and destination
atomic checkpoint, approval consumption, and outbox intent
attempt hash, provider response hash, and idempotency key
destination receipt plus durable pending-interrupt snapshot
ambiguous destination state with no safe automatic retry proof
verified destination receipt plus pending-interrupt snapshot
typed permanent release failure plus pending-interrupt snapshot
empty pending-interrupt ledger and verified release receipt
empty pending-interrupt ledger and reconciled permanent release failure
durable pending cancellation after release reconciliation
durable pending timeout after release reconciliation
durable pending budget exhaustion after release reconciliation

global_interrupts.deferred_behavior: record pending cancellation, reconcile any visible proposal release, then honor cancellation
record pending timeout, reconcile any visible proposal release, then honor timeout
block new work, record pending budget exhaustion, reconcile release, then terminate

budgets.soft_boundary: At 80 percent of any measurable budget, stop expanding candidates, preserve evidence and receipts, and prepare a local PROPOSED, PLATEAU, or safe handoff verdict.

no_progress.fingerprint: hash of normalized evidence ids, association snapshot, candidate semantic fields, counterexample, unresolved falsifiers, producer version, evaluator receipt, and threshold version
no_progress.gain_metric: evidence fidelity gain plus novelty gain plus resolved falsifier value plus semantic compression gain after lexical and duplicate normalization
no_progress.calibration: versioned weights and epsilon calibrated on labeled Eureka candidate and revision rounds with a frozen holdout
no_progress.scope: bounded correction subloop only; external release is never used to evade a creative plateau
no_progress.plateau_comparator: every diversified revision in the window has normalized weighted gain below epsilon or repeats the same semantic fingerprint

retry.backoff: bounded exponential backoff with recorded jitter supplied by the external governor

effects.delivery_semantics: at-least-once with content-addressed deduplication and destination receipt where supported
effects.idempotency_key: run_id, transition_id, effect_sequence, workflow_version, adapter_version, candidate_or_artifact_hash, destination_hash
effects.durable_ledger: intent, exact input hash, approval consumption, attempt, response, receipt, acknowledgement, pending interrupt, and compensation or abandonment status
effects.high_risk_gate: Only optional publication of a bundle visibly labeled PROPOSED is high-risk; it is reachable solely through exact-content WAIT_RELEASE_APPROVAL and RELEASE_INTENT and can never confer canon acceptance.
effects.unknown_outcome: enter HUMAN_RECONCILIATION and inspect the destination; never blindly retry proposal publication

boundaries: after recording each model, retrieval, or evaluator response
after release receipt or unknown outcome
checkpoint.compatibility: resume only the same immutable workflow, candidate, scoring, receipt, and state schema versions
checkpoint.migration: explicit audited upcaster and state migration; never reinterpret an old receipt under a new gate silently
checkpoint.fencing: single-runner lease token and expected aggregate version are checked on every commit
checkpoint.monotonic_sequence: checkpoint sequence, event sequence, aggregate version, and budget consumption increase together
checkpoint.integrity: checksum state, evidence snapshots, model responses, receipts, pending effects and interrupts, and version envelope
checkpoint.corruption_outcome: quarantine the run as a typed permanent failure and require recovery review

approval.revocation: revocation before RELEASE_INTENT commit invalidates the optional external-release approval
approval.stale_outcome: return to READY_TO_PROPOSE and require a new approval; local PROPOSE-only return remains available

verification.success_predicate: PROPOSED requires an immutable candidate hash, cited recorded evidence, all versioned deterministic gates, a distinct-evaluator pass receipt bound to the original contract and evidence; external release additionally requires a matching destination receipt.
invariant_checks: Eureka never emits ACCEPTED or materializes KG or source changes
producer and evaluator identity families are distinct
receipt candidate, evidence, contract, and threshold hashes match
budgets and retries are monotonic and bounded
terminal states have no outgoing transitions
stylistic-only revision cannot reset the no-progress window
verification.environment_evidence: content-addressed pattern and association snapshots, recorded model responses, deterministic score components, counterexamples, evaluator receipts, and optional release receipts are independent of producer prose
verification.evaluator_independence: the evaluator cannot be the candidate producer, receives the original contract and evidence, and cannot alone authorize a proposal when deterministic gates fail
verification.human_gray_band: threshold-near, evaluator-disputed, attribution-ambiguous, or external-release-unknown outcomes require human review and never become silent success
verification.calibration: freeze labeled production-like candidates, report false accepts and false rejects by gate, version thresholds, monitor drift, and keep exploration scores separate from the proposal gate
fault_tests: receipt replay against changed candidate content
repeated semantic fingerprint and stylistic churn
budget and timeout during every safe state
crash before and after model response recording
duplicate external release and unknown destination outcome
expired, revoked, replayed, or content-mismatched approval

replay.resume: continue from a compatible integrity-checked checkpoint under a fresh fenced lease, preserving pending interrupts and effect state
replay.trajectory_replay: re-run downstream association, model, or evaluator work and permit divergence while creating a new run lineage
deterministic_replay_requirements: frozen workflow, schema, prompt, model, tool, scorer, and threshold versions
captured clock, random, identifier, ordering, and jitter values
recorded association, producer, evaluator, and release responses
read-only sandbox with external effects stubbed from receipts

security.untrusted_content: source text, retrieved associations, model output, evaluator prose, and claimed citations are data and cannot alter control flow except through typed validated observations
security.tool_least_privilege: default execution is read-only and PROPOSE-only; model, retrieval, checkpoint, and optional publication capabilities are separately allowlisted
security.provenance_snapshots: store source path or URI, retrieval time, content hash, parser and adapter versions, security domain, and redaction policy
security.secret_isolation: retrieved content and candidate producers never receive persistence or publication credentials; evaluator and publisher credentials are separated

trace.redaction: exclude or encrypt prompts, source payloads, secrets, credentials, private identifiers, and human approval rationale according to capability-scoped policy

icvc.inform: versioned input contract, evidence and association provenance, candidate schema, budgets, threshold version, and visible uncertainty
icvc.constrain: typed FSM, PROPOSE-only authority, least-privilege ports, independent evaluator binding, bounded correction, no-progress gate, and hard external interrupts
icvc.verify: deterministic falsifiers, original evidence, distinct-evaluator receipt, calibrated gray band, trace completeness, and optional destination receipt
icvc.correct: bounded revision using explicit falsifiers and marginal semantic gain; plateau, retry exhaustion, and budget exhaustion remain honest terminal outcomes
